authority: User requested an in-repository compact expandable source cache, repository agent coordination, integration on main, and formal durable decision techniques. Repository records do not create new authority.

decisions.choice: Store immutable compressed source bytes and occurrence paths; formally model exact indexed dictionaries.
decisions.reason: Sharing payload storage must preserve every ordered key/payload occurrence, including duplicate keys and payloads.
decisions.mathematical_contract: IndexedDictionary.unpack_pack and packing injectivity; no hash or serializer law assumed.
decisions.runtime_boundary: Python/zlib/filesystem adapter is separately tested; refinement to Lean remains open.

decisions.choice: Require exact agreement at every referenced dictionary lookup when reusing decoded content.
decisions.reason: Same counts, valid indices and equal overall failures can conceal changed payloads.

decisions.choice: Freeze Git-tracked plus nonignored untracked first-party GRWTSK Lean files and root GRWTSK.lean; record catalogs and build/license context separately.
decisions.reason: A finite declared identity set makes omission checks and byte expansion reviewable.
limits: External dependency bytes and implicit imports are outside source snapshot scope.
Lexical import edges are observations rather than elaboration certificates.
Captured source role and historical receipts never imply current proof acceptance.

decisions.choice: Use immutable manifests, expected-parent compare-and-swap, retained history and failures, and reverse reachability on old/new dependency graph union.
decisions.reason: Source changes and concurrent writers must remain observable without erasing historical evidence.
limits: No globally atomic filesystem/source freeze theorem.
SHA256 is byte-identity bookkeeping; mathematical injectivity is not assumed.
Operational algorithm refinement to finite closure models remains open.

decisions.choice: Preserve all 16 supplied family labels and declared counts totaling 215 while leaving the absent individual method identity inventory explicitly incomplete.
decisions.reason: Count equality cannot establish exact record coverage. Mathematical subject/object remains canonical primary placement.
limits: Statistical diagnostics require their own applicability premises and do not replace structural identity checks.

decisions.choice: Keep taxonomy parents, aliases, provenance, formal implication, dependencies, communication and governance distinct.
decisions.reason: Reachability and source custody alone establish neither a theorem nor permission.
limits: Incoming prefix-tree taxonomy versus cache acyclic diamonds needs an explicit representation map.
Identity-preserving history does not yet establish an exact append-only sequence refinement.

decisions.choice: Work on main, retain conflicting source/index variants and integrate concurrent progress.
decisions.reason: The user explicitly requires shared-main work and preservation of concurrent stability evidence.
limits: No remote push or remote branch mutation is authorized.
Only stale worktree metadata or wholly owned obsolete work is eligible for cleanup.

contributions.role: formal models, adapters, controls, source review and integration; author self-review is not independent validation

status: design decisions bound to explicit premises; selected Lean results checked; runtime refinement and full method catalog open
